actions.action: Check soil moisture 5 cm deep with finger
Water slowly until it drains if dry, empty saucer after 10 minutes
Move plant to bright indirect light (outdoor shade or indoor sunny window) for 2 weeks
Gradually reintroduce morning sun, moving plant in and out daily
Remove dry crispy leaves and dead leaves from soil surface
